confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Mumbai price levels for a July 2026 window; no live booking pages, menus, or current listings were inspected. Restaurant anchors (meals, coffee, beer) are more reliable than hotel and hostel anchors, which vary widely by neighbourhood, season, and booking channel. Cocktail and wine_glass were estimated from typical Mumbai bar pricing relative to beer, since direct knowledge of those prices is weaker. Mumbai is priced well above most other Indian cities, so the anchors reflect Mumbai rather than national averages. The FX observation came from a web search of the RBA summary pages, which reported 0.6955 USD per AUD as at 4.00 pm on 2026-10-15. The full F11.1 daily data table was not retrieved.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used. Estimates are based on Mumbai's position as India's most expensive metro, priced above Delhi, Bengaluru, and Pune for hotels and bars but well below Southeast Asian and European capitals for food and lodging. Restaurant and bar prices are scaled to typical Mumbai mid-range establishments with the local excise and service-charge effects included.
